read.thesis: Core banking franchise grew: NII $16.6B (+8% YoY) with yield 2.16% and 2026 NII guided ~8%, 2027 8%+; markets and IB soft, $1.2B AML settlement charge, CET1 10.9%.

triggers.label: 2027 NII growth 8% or more
triggers.quote: For 2027, we currently expect full-year growth of NII to be 8% or more, higher than 2026

triggers.label: NIM 2.16%, up 15bp YoY
triggers.quote: Net interest yield of 2.16% improved 15 basis points year-over-year

triggers.label: Commercial loans up 8% YoY
triggers.quote: Commercial loans increased 8% year-over-year, with growth across every line of business

guidance.quote: We still expect to hit that full-year revised NII growth guidance of approximately 8%.
For 2027, we currently expect full-year growth of NII to be 8% or more
it's not going to change from the 200-300 basis points

red_flags.label: $1.2B non-tax-deductible AML/sanctions regulatory settlement charge
red_flags.quote: a non-tax-deductible regulatory settlement charge of $1.2 billion

evasions.quote: we do not guide the two differently and independently for a variety of different reasons
We need to wait for the final rules.
